name: Tsuma wa Kon'ya mo Ubawareru ~Seiso Kei Kyonyuu Hitozuma wa Choukyouzumi Niku Ana Dorei~
original_name: 妻は今夜も奪われる～清楚系巨乳人妻は調教済み肉穴奴隷～
source:

...

Or is she a loving wife masquerading as a slut to protect her happiness with you? ……
You are about to find out: ……
